source: Week 2 of the Nov 8 cycle, rebuilt Sunday 1pm from the Nov 15 inventory walkthrough (+ onions, potatoes, sweet potatoes added). No store run planned: Sunday prep is 100% on hand and the rest of the week needs at most one optional item. Nothing from week 1 got cooked, so the thawed fridge proteins go first and three week-1 recipes come back.

targets.austin: ~1800 (1750–1900), 150g+. Workout days Mon + Wed (soccer): +300–400 cal at dinner.

ingredient_overlap: Sweet potatoes → Sun dinner, lunch jars, Mon hash + workout carb, Fri lunch, Cameron's tuna sides. Red onion → pickled (salad, lunches, Sat steak, tuna base). Yellow onion → kofta, ragù, Fri stir-fry. Potatoes → Tue Gruyère chicken + Sat smashed. Cucumbers ×3 → tzatziki, Greek salad, lunch jars, tuna base, Mon salmon. Kale → lunch jars, Tue, Wed ragù, Sat slaw. Feta → kofta, salad, lunches, tuna. Coconut milk → rice + Fri sauce. Gruyère → Tue + ragù topping + gnocchi.
flexible_order: Tue chicken and Wed ragù can't slide later (thawed chicken; ragù is fine to Thu). Fri and Sat can swap if you start the smoker Friday.
assumptions: Thawed salmon covers 8 oz Austin + 5 oz Cameron; if it's only 2 × 5 oz, Austin adds 2 eggs.
Tuna: ~6 cans = Cameron's 6 lunches Mon–Sat; Austin eats leftovers Thu–Sat instead.

prep.cycle_note: Cycle Nov 8 → 21, week 2 of 2 (refresh week). Week 1's dinners were never cooked, so the thawed fridge proteins go first (salmon, lamb, chicken, flat iron, sausage) and the sweet potatoes get roasted today. Sunday prep is all on hand (~1h55 hands-on). No grocery run this week: Friday's Thai night swapped satay for a coconut-lime sauce, Parmesan → Gruyère, broccoli → frozen pepper blend. Freezer bank into the Nov 22 cycle: ~2 ragù portions, extra kofta, extra sweet potato, ribeye, 4 sausage links, ~3 lb wings, tilapia, 2 chicken thighs, 1 flat iron.

items.name: Already thawed in the fridge: salmon, ground lamb, 2 chicken breasts, flat iron, 2 sausage links. Nothing to pull Friday night this week.
items.why: These set the order: salmon Mon, lamb Sun, chicken Tue, flat iron Sun sear, sausage into Sunday's ragù.
